expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.U===9 && S.R1===10 && S.R2===30 && S.R3===60 && S.probe==='A' && S.ground==='F' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: U = 9,0 V, R1 = 10, R2 = 30, R3 = 60 ohm, probe A, reference the minus pole (must run before any setup)
on load: I1 = 9,0 V : 30 ohm = 0,30 A (lesson-answers sim-I1)
on load: I2 = 6,0 V : 30 ohm = 0,20 A (sim-I2)
on load: I3 = 6,0 V : 60 ohm = 0,10 A (sim-I3)
on load: R23 = 20 ohm (sim-R23)
on load: U1 = 3,0 V (sim-U1)
on load: U2 = 6,0 V (sim-U23)
on load: V_A = 9,0 V (sim-VA)
on load: V_B = 6,0 V (sim-VB)
on load: V_F = 0 V
on load: meter at A: 9,0 V
on load: loop sum U - U1 - U2 = 0

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const ok=(r,a,b,s)=>r.min===a&&r.max===b&&r.step===s; return R.length===4 && ok(R[0],'1','12','0.5') && ok(R[1],'5','100','5') && ok(R[2],'10','120','5') && ok(R[3],'10','120','5') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: four sliders: U 1-12 V by 0,5; R1 5-100 ohm by 5; R2 and R3 10-120 ohm by 5
two selects: probe point A-F and reference point (minus pole F or junction B)
DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='R1,R2,R3,U,ground,probe' && P.U.unit==='V' && P.R3.unit==='Ω' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares U (V), R1-R3 (ohm), probe and ground

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?966:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x966 (stacked, larger labels, the meter under the circuit) under 500 px
the readout shows the currents and the meter reading
